header.tagline: Business Systems Developer | Epicor Integrations | C# / .NET

summary: Systems Developer specializing in C#/.NET and Epicor Kinetic ERP. I build the integrations, APIs, and business intelligence that cut waste and drive smarter operational decisions. Outside of work, I’m a family man who enjoys building custom tools to manage a busy household.

details.label: Cost Optimization
details.text: Engineered a PowerShell/JSON middleware to automate BarTender label population via Epicor Web APIs, saving $15,000 annually by eliminating redundant database replication services.

details.label: System Integration
details.text: Partnered with Software Development to engineer Web API integrations between custom applications and Epicor Kinetic; utilized NSwag and OpenAPI (Swagger) to generate type-safe clients, automating Kanban, scrap/DMR processing, and shipping documentation.

details.label: Process Automation
details.text: Developed a modular C# library for Epicor API integrations to refactor and automate ToolBoss inventory synchronization; additionally automated monthly labor data imports using PowerShell and Epicor DMT to eliminate manual reconciliation errors and save data entry time.

details.label: UI/UX Customization
details.text: Migrated legacy customizations to the Kinetic SaaS UI using Application Studio, developing custom event-driven UI layers to enhance user experience and workflow.

details.label: Team Documentation
details.text: Created a centralized documentation site and onboarding resources using MkDocs to streamline developer training and standardize departmental processes.
